review_method.source_comparison: Compared the source with nine evenly spaced decoded frames and the 3x3 contact sheet.
review_method.technical_verification: Rechecked the recorded duration, dimensions, audio flag, SHA-256, and motion-metrics receipt.

observations.requested_motion: Only opacity should decrease inside the exact first-frame purple footprint; its size and shape must remain identical.
observations.camera: The camera and square framing remain fixed.
stable_elements: Cyrillic labels remain legible after the overlay clears
The underlying diagram topology remains recognizable
invariant_failures: The purple wash expands from 0.357 to 0.993 of the measured ROI despite the explicit no-size-change constraint.
The cloud spills over labels, the uterus, scales, and lower connector region; up to 32.62 percent of pixels outside the fixed ROI change.
The measured trajectory has seven material monotonic-decrease violations before the wash fades.
The provider returned 1440x1440 with audio despite the requested 1080p no-audio contract.

verdict.summary: Opacity-only wording did not preserve the footprint; it produced the largest spatial bloom in the experiment before fading.
